The quarterly session of the Isthmian Canal Commission, which,
under the Executive Order of April 1, 1905, would ordinarily be held
on the first day of October, next, may be held at the office of the
Governor of the Canal Zone on the Isthmus of Panama on the 15th day
of November, 1906, instead of on the date above mentioned.
Theodore Roosevelt,
President.
The White House, September 20, 1906.

Equivalent boundary is the close of November 15. No meeting performance or adjournment is inferred. Specific authority to substitute November15,1906 for the October1 quarterly-session date expires at end of November15 inclusive. Exclusive boundary November16 00:00 local; excluding November15 itself would wrongly negate expressly authorized day. No performance inferred. Parent permits any lawfully commenced session to continue as public business requires; such continuation and historical validity are consequences of that parent, not fresh EO:506 scheduling power. No other independent command.
